name: 3D Bresenham Voxel Tracing
aliases: Fast Voxel Traversal Algorithm for Ray Tracing
summary: 3D Bresenham Voxel Tracing is a discrete ray traversal algorithm for uniform 3D voxel grids that uses integer arithmetic and error accumulation to step through adjacent voxels, making it computationally cheaper and immune to floating-point precision errors.
